lease queue on a real Postgres + PostgREST (local, isolated) F: the job dies twice; the sweep gives it up, refunds the charge once, and a second sweep pays nothing more
lease queue on a real Postgres + PostgREST (local, isolated) a debt left on a failed row (the refund did not land) is paid by the next sweep, once
lease queue on a real Postgres + PostgREST (local, isolated) the owner stops a running job: the worker hears it on its heartbeat, delivers nothing, and the charge comes back once
lease queue on a real Postgres + PostgREST (local, isolated) a charge whose request died before it lifted the hold is failed after HOLD_MS and paid back
lease queue on a real Postgres + PostgREST (local, isolated) eight workers race for one queued job through PostgREST: exactly one gets it
lease queue on a real Postgres + PostgREST (local, isolated) E/F for the URL-to-Audio worker: a dead extraction is retried once and delivered; two deaths are given up
